Why coaches choose this over Trainerize or Everfit

Three things most coaching platforms don't do.

01 · EVIDENCE

Every habit is backed by a real study, not a generic tip.

The habit library is built condition by condition: PCOS, thyroid, diabetes, heart health, with each habit citing the research behind it, so you can explain "why" with confidence, every time.

Not a guess. A citation.
02 · SUPERVISION

AI never touches a client's data unsupervised.

Blood reports, meal plans, habit suggestions: AI assists, but nothing saves until you personally review and confirm it. Your judgment stays the last word, always.

You confirm. Always.
03 · HONESTY

No streaks, no badges, no manufactured pressure.

Numbers are never dressed up past what they can support. A thin sample says so. A missed day doesn't wear a red X. This is a deliberate stance most platforms won't take, because gamification is their whole engagement model.

Real progress, honestly shown.

AI Insights for Clients

Blood Report AI

Questions coaches actually ask

FAQ

Is my clients' data secure?+

Yes, every client gets a private, unguessable link with no public listing. Sensitive data like blood reports is coach-only and never AI-auto-saved without your confirmation.

I already use WhatsApp and Excel. Why switch?+

You can keep using WhatsApp for the relationship. This just replaces the scattered spreadsheets and screenshots with one real system your client actually logs into daily.

Can I customize habits per client's condition?+

Completely. Toggle any habit on or off per client, add your own custom ones, or pull a habit from a different condition's library entirely.

What happens after the Founding Coach spots fill up?+

Your price stays locked in for as long as you're a coach on the platform. Only coaches joining after the founding cohort pay standard pricing.
